jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: A "Manager" title at the Project/Regional Lead pay band, and a strategic-litigation lead role plainly requires senior experience and very likely a legal background the candidate lacks. The human-rights mission is a perfect interest match, but the level and qualification are hard mismatches.
jobs.salary: £52,088 plus up to 5% employee matched pension contribution

jobs.title: Fundraising Coordinator
jobs.reason: Entry-level (Coordinator band) and not disqualified, but it is a fundraising role drawing on dedicated fundraising and donor-management skills the candidate does not have, so paper fit is weak. The human-rights organisation is appealing, but the function sits well outside the candidate's research and policy strengths.
jobs.salary: £32,696 per annum plus up to 5% employee matched pension contribution

jobs.title: Investment Manager
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — a Manager title with a £90k–£150k salary clearly signals a senior investment professional with substantial relevant experience the candidate lacks. The role is also outside the candidate's research/policy field and skill set.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee — not a genuine paid entry-level role, and it explicitly seeks experienced practitioners/activists from specific regions (East Africa, Latin America, Southeast Asia), which the candidate is not. It reads as a voluntary/advisory expert appointment rather than a salaried vacancy, so it fails the genuine-paid-role gate despite the strong human-rights subject match.

jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: This is the most senior executive post in the organisation — a Director leading three Deputy Directors with ultimate executive responsibility — far beyond an entry-level candidate with only student-assistant experience. The level is a hard mismatch despite the London location.

jobs.title: Fellow, Climate policy & development
jobs.reason: A "Fellow" role at a think-tank of CGD's standing is a senior research position requiring a strong track record (typically a PhD and/or several years of established expertise) in climate and development economics — well beyond the candidate's entry-level profile. The field is also outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Senior Fellow and Director Smart Buys Alliance
jobs.reason: A Senior Fellow and Director title is a clearly senior leadership role requiring many years of experience, and it is based in Washington DC with no London option, failing the London-only location filter. Both the level and location are hard disqualifiers.

jobs.title: Senior Process Analyst - Celonis
jobs.reason: Ineligible on multiple counts: it is a "Senior" role requiring 5+ years of experience, and its essential requirements (Celonis certification, data engineering, SQL/ETL pipelines, scripting-level Python) are deep-technical skills well beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python. It also sits entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee — it requires established subject-matter expertise the candidate (an early-career student) does not yet have, and it reads as a voluntary/advisory committee role rather than a genuine paid early-career position. The human-rights and securitisation theme is interesting, but the seniority/expertise expectation and unpaid advisory nature are disqualifying.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Funding Management - Directed Activities
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — this is a Senior Manager role requiring significant research-funding experience and proven team leadership, which the candidate's student-assistant background does not meet. The funding-allocation experience at the German Rectors' Conference is tangentially relevant, but the level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Administrator (Maternity Cover, 12 Month FTC)
jobs.reason: A purely administrative / executive-assistant role — calendar management, travel booking, meeting logistics — which sits well outside the candidate's research and policy profile despite Fitch being a credible financial-information firm. The bachelor's-degree-OR-5-years framing keeps it eligible (a degree alone qualifies, so no hard 3+ year gate), but the work is clerical with little research substance and no interest pull, so it lands low.

jobs.title: Research Leader - R&I policy/Metascience - Science and Emerging Technology
jobs.reason: This is a senior leadership role requiring a proven track record of leading teams, winning bids and managing large complex evaluations — well beyond the candidate's entry-level profile with no full-time experience. The metascience / R&I policy focus is also outside the core interest zones.

jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — this is a senior Director role deputising for the CEO, requiring extensive senior leadership experience and a record of leading research teams, none of which the candidate has. The economic / living-standards policy focus also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.
jobs.type: Full-time / Part-time (min. 4 days a week), Permanent

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee – Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an Advisory Committee — it seeks established subject-matter specialists with deep expertise on climate-justice securitisation and defender criminalisation, not an entry-level paid role, and it is effectively an advisory/voluntary committee rather than a genuine paid position the candidate would hold. The human-rights subject is on-mission, but the seniority and nature of the role are hard mismatches.

jobs.title: Senior Lecturer / Lecturer (School of Construction Economics and Management)
jobs.reason: Lecturer/Senior Lecturer roles in built-environment fields (project management, quantity surveying, real estate finance) are academic posts requiring a Master's/PhD in construction or business management plus teaching, supervision and publication track records the candidate lacks; the Senior Lecturer rank explicitly requires a completed PhD. The subject area is entirely outside the candidate's international-law and policy specialism, making this a hard mismatch on both qualification and field.

jobs.title: Payroll Advisor
jobs.reason: Not entry-level and outside the candidate's field — it requires payroll qualifications, strong technical payroll experience and managerial competencies the candidate lacks. The role is in finance/HR operations, entirely outside the candidate's research and policy profile and interest zones.

jobs.title: Communications Coordinator (Accommodation)
jobs.reason: This is an entry-level, paid London role the candidate could technically hold, but the essential requirements centre on content creation, social media management software (Sprout Social, MailChimp), digital design tools and dedicated marketing-campaign experience — a clear gap given the candidate's limited comms/marketing background. The subject (accommodation operations) sits well outside all three interest zones, so it ranks low despite being eligible.
jobs.salary: £32,890–£36,052 (progressing to £38,422) pa inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Editorial Programme Co-ordinator
jobs.reason: Disqualified on the essential requirement of 3–5 years' experience in an editorial project co-ordination role, which the candidate's student-assistant background does not meet. The role is also outside all three interest zones — educational publishing co-ordination focused on TVET curriculum compliance, with no research or policy substance relevant to the candidate's profile.

jobs.title: Senior Supporter Retention Officer – Appeals and Islamic Giving
jobs.reason: This is a "Senior" fundraising / supporter-retention role with a salary band implying several years of relevant experience the candidate lacks; the title and level are a hard mismatch. It is also a specialist fundraising/Islamic-giving function far from the candidate's research and policy profile.

jobs.title: Director of Operations
jobs.reason: This is a Director-level Senior Leadership Team post requiring significant senior finance and operations experience, board governance and company secretary expertise — far beyond entry-level and a clear hard disqualifier on seniority. The candidate has no professional finance/operations leadership background, and the environmental-finance subject is outside the core interest zones.

jobs.title: Accountability to Affected Populations (AAP) Officer
jobs.reason: Location policy is London only, and this role is onsite in Gaza with no London or remote option, which is a hard filter. It is also a field humanitarian-accountability post likely requiring regional/operational experience and Arabic, outside the candidate's profile.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Adviser
jobs.reason: A "Senior" title implying substantial post-qualification experience, and a Legal Adviser role that requires a legal qualification the candidate does not hold. The accountability/justice field is a perfect interest match, but both the seniority and the qualification are unmet essentials.

jobs.title: Advisory Board Member
jobs.reason: An advisory board position is a senior governance role requiring established expertise and seniority the candidate plainly lacks. Not an entry-level paid role for an early-career candidate.

jobs.title: Internship - Speculative Opportunities
jobs.reason: Internship postings are excluded as a matter of policy, and this is also a speculative talent-pool listing with no concrete vacancy. The field would be a perfect match, but the role type gates it.

jobs.title: IT Officer
jobs.reason: An IT Officer role requires technical IT/systems administration skills that are outside the candidate's analysis-level profile and not relevant to their research background. Wrong skills set entirely.

jobs.title: IT Security Officer
jobs.reason: An IT security role requires dedicated information-security / systems expertise the candidate does not have. This is a deep-technical fit mismatch outside the candidate's profile.

jobs.title: Speculative Application
jobs.reason: A purely speculative "talent pool" listing with no concrete vacancy, which is excluded by policy. There is no actual role to assess fit against.

jobs.title: Audio Visual Producer (Factual)
jobs.reason: The essential criteria require proven experience producing video/podcast content in a commercial environment and overseeing multi-camera studio shoots — production and media skills the candidate does not have. It is also not entry-level (a lead/oversight producer role) and sits entirely outside the candidate's research, policy and intelligence interest zones.
